description: This Java class, ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo, is part of the Apache OFBiz web tools framework. It represents detailed artifact information about a screen widget, including its associated entities, services, forms, linked requests, and views. The class provides methods for populating these relationships from model data and for retrieving them, supporting project features such as documentation, dependency analysis, and code navigation.

classes.name: ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents artifact information about a specific screen widget within the OFBiz web tools framework, including its associated entities, services, forms, linked requests, and views, with methods for populating and retrieving this data.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates the artifact info with entities, services, forms, and linked requests based on the model screen data.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Populates the set of services used in this screen from a given set of service names.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Populates the set of entities used in this screen from a given set of entity names.

methods.name: populateFormsFromNameSet
methods.description: Populates the set of forms included in this screen from a given set of form names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Populates the set of request objects linked to this screen from a set of request IDs.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable display name for this screen artifact.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type string, 'Screen Widget'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for this artifact.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier string for this screen artifact.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL location of the screen resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on screen name and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code based on string representation.

methods.name: getViewsReferringToScreen
methods.description: Retrieves related view artifacts that refer to this screen.

methods.name: getEntitiesUsedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of entity artifacts used in this screen.

methods.name: getServicesUsedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of service artifacts used in this screen.

methods.name: getFormsIncludedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of form widget artifacts included in this screen.

methods.name: getScreensIncludedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of screens included within this screen (currently unimplemented).

methods.name: getScreensIncludingThisScreen
methods.description: Returns screens that include this screen.

methods.name: getRequestsLinkedToInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of linked request artifacts associated with this screen.
